name: yt-dl-studio
description: Local yt-dlp download studio with a Go server and React interface

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix web && go vet ./...
scripts.test: npm run api:check && npm run build:frontend && npm test --prefix web && go test -timeout 90s ./...
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint && npm audit --omit=dev && npm audit --prefix web --omit=dev
